# Inspire Sleep

> > Inspire Sleep offers FDA-approved implantable therapy as a mask-free alternative to CPAP for treating obstructive sleep apnea.

Inspire Medical Systems, Inc. develops and markets Inspire®, an innovative neurostimulation implant for sleep apnea patients. The site provides comprehensive patient education, physician resources, treatment information, and insurance guidance to help patients understand eligibility and access this breakthrough therapy.

## Key Topics

- Inspire® therapy
- Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA)
- CPAP alternative
- FDA-approved implant
- Sleep apnea treatment
- Patient qualification
- Implant procedure
- Insurance coverage
- Medicare
- Inspire® app
- Neurostimulation
- Sleep disorder specialists
- Patient outcomes
- Inspire Medical Systems
- Mask-free therapy

## Getting Started with Inspire

- [Sleep Apnea Treatment | Inspire® therapy](https://www.inspiresleep.com/en-us): Homepage introducing Inspire therapy as FDA-approved CPAP alternative for sleep apnea
- [Do I Qualify for Inspire® Therapy? | Inspire Sleep Apnea](https://www.inspiresleep.com/en-us/do-i-qualify): Patient qualification quiz and criteria screening for Inspire therapy eligibility
- [How Does Inspire® Therapy Work? | Sleep Apnea Innovation](https://www.inspiresleep.com/en-us/how-inspire-therapy-works): Educational guide explaining FDA-approved Inspire implant mechanism and procedure
- [Sleep Apnea Education | Inspire Sleep Apnea Innovation](https://www.inspiresleep.com/en-us/sleep-apnea-education): Educational resource covering OSA, CSA, symptoms, diagnosis, and Inspire treatment options
- [Inspire FAQ | Inspire Sleep Apnea Innovation](https://www.inspiresleep.com/en-us/faq): Comprehensive FAQ addressing Inspire therapy process, recovery, and daily life questions

## Patient Support & Resources

- [Doctors Near Me | Inspire Sleep Apnea Innovation](https://www.inspiresleep.com/en-us/find-a-doctor): Provider locator tool to find Inspire-trained sleep disorder specialists by location

- [Inspire Patient Ambassadors | Inspire Sleep Apnea Innovation](https://www.inspiresleep.com/en-us/ambassadors): Patient ambassador network providing peer support and personal guidance on Inspire therapy
- [Sleep Event - Inspire® Therapy Events | Inspire Sleep](https://www.inspiresleep.com/en-us/events): Virtual and in-person events with patient testimonials and expert education on Inspire
